```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(lattice)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(nlme)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
analysis1 <- read_csv("G:/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1tq5G_UrV2_qbv2NCEdtjrFOH7Vjyuz0H/JHS data/analysis1.csv")
analysis2 <- read_csv("G:/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1tq5G_UrV2_qbv2NCEdtjrFOH7Vjyuz0H/JHS data/analysis2.csv")
analysis3 <- read_csv("G:/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1tq5G_UrV2_qbv2NCEdtjrFOH7Vjyuz0H/JHS data/analysis3.csv")
```

```{r}
#fixing diab3cat

#diab3cat 0 non, 1 pre, 2 diabetic
diab_levels <- c(
  "Non-Diabetic",
  "Pre-Diabetic",
  "Diabetic"
)

analysis1$diab3cat <- factor(
  analysis1$diab3cat,
  levels = diab_levels
)

analysis2$diab3cat <- factor(
  analysis2$diab3cat,
  levels = 0:2,
  labels = diab_levels
)

analysis3$diab3cat <- factor(
  analysis3$diab3cat,
  levels = 0:2,
  labels = diab_levels
)

unique(analysis1$diab3cat)
unique(analysis2$diab3cat)
unique(analysis3$diab3cat)
```

```{r}
#fixing DialysisEver
names(analysis2)[names(analysis2) == "dialysisEver"] <- "DialysisEver"

analysis1$DialysisEver <- factor(
  analysis1$DialysisEver,
  levels = c("No", "Yes")
)

analysis2$DialysisEver <- factor(
  analysis2$DialysisEver,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("No", "Yes")
)

analysis3$DialysisEver <- factor(
  analysis3$DialysisEver,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("No", "Yes")
)

unique(analysis1$DialysisEver)
unique(analysis2$DialysisEver)
unique(analysis3$DialysisEver)
```

```{r}
longway <- bind_rows(analysis1, analysis2, analysis3)
head(longway)
```

```{r}
#checking longway
longway %>%
  group_by(subjid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_visits = n_distinct(visit),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  count(n_visits)

longway %>%
  count(subjid, visit) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

longway %>%
  select(subjid, visit, VisitDate, DaysFromV1, YearsFromV1) %>%
  arrange(subjid, visit) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
barkbark <- unique(c(names(analysis1), names(analysis2),names(analysis3)))

barkmeow <- data.frame(variable = barkbark,
                       analysis1 = barkbark %in% names(analysis1),
                       analysis2 = barkbark %in% names(analysis2),
                       analysis3 = barkbark %in% names(analysis3)
                )
kable(head(barkmeow))

#in all 3
commons <- Reduce(intersect, list(names(analysis1), names(analysis2), names(analysis3)))
kable(commons)

#only in 1
kable(setdiff(names(analysis1), union(names(analysis2), names(analysis3))))

#only in 2
kable(setdiff(names(analysis2), union(names(analysis1), names(analysis3))))

#only in 3
kable(setdiff(names(analysis3), union(names(analysis1), names(analysis2))))

#structure subj id -> a1 a2 a3
```

```{r}
longway_com <- longway[, commons]
longway_com <- arrange(longway_com, subjid)
```

```{r}
#R3.1 p 40
xy1 <-xyplot(sbp ~ YearsFromV1,
       groups = subjid,
       data = longway_com,
       type = "l",
       lty = 1)
xy1

xy2 <-xyplot(sbp ~ YearsFromV1 | Diabetes,
       groups = subjid,
       data = longway_com,
       type = "l",
       lty = 1)
xy2

xy3 <-xyplot(sbp ~ YearsFromV1 | sex,
       groups = subjid,
       data = longway_com,
       type = "l",
       lty = 1)
xy3
```

```{r}
#R3.2
#checking visit patterns
visit_pattern <- longway_com %>%
  group_by(subjid) %>%
  summarise(visits = paste(sort(unique(visit)), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop")

table(visit_pattern$visits)
```

All 2653 subjects appeared at all 3 visits.

```{r}
#checking diabetes patterns
diabetes_pattern <- longway_com %>%
  arrange(subjid, visit) %>%
  group_by(subjid) %>%
  summarise(diabetes_pattern = paste(ifelse(is.na(Diabetes), "Missing", as.character(Diabetes)), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop")

diabetes_pattern %>% count(diabetes_pattern) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% kable()
```

The second visit appears to have the most missing recordings of diabetes status.

```{r}
#check sex
table(longway_com$sex, useNA = "ifany")
table(longway_com$visit, longway_com$sex, useNA = "ifany")
```

No changes in sex.

```{r}
#R3.3 p42
#summary stats

sbp_summary <- longway_com %>%
  group_by(YearsFromV1, sex) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(sbp)),
    mean_sbp = mean(sbp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sbp = sd(sbp, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sbp = median(sbp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

kable(sbp_summary)
```

```{r}
#R3.4 p43
bw1 <- bwplot(sbp ~ factor(visit) | sex, data = longway_com)
bw1
```


```{r}
#R3.5 number of patients by sex and missing-data pattern? p46
longway_com %>%
  filter(is.na(sbp)) %>%
  select(subjid, visit, YearsFromV1, sex, sbp)
```


```{r}
#fig3.4 47
sbp_complete <- longway_com %>%
  select(subjid, visit, sbp) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = visit,
    values_from = sbp,
    names_prefix = "SBP_V"
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

pairs.panels(
  sbp_complete[, c("SBP_V1", "SBP_V2", "SBP_V3")],
  method = "pearson",
  hist.col = "thistle"
)
#uses pysch lib
```


```{r}
#var cov mx R3.6 p48
sbp_x <- sbp_complete[, c("SBP_V1", "SBP_V2", "SBP_V3")]
(varx <- var(sbp_x, use = "complete.obs"))  #varcov mx

print(cor(sbp_x, use = "complete.obs")) #correlation mx
diag(varx) #diag of cov mx

kable(cov2cor(varx)) #sam as cor() cor mx
```


```{r}
#hypertension
table(longway_com$HTN, useNA = "ifany")
table(longway_com$visit,longway_com$HTN,useNA = "ifany")

#did htn stay same
longway_com %>%
  group_by(subjid) %>%
  summarise(n_HTN = n_distinct(HTN, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(n_HTN)

baseline_htn <- longway_com %>%
  filter(visit == 1) %>%
  select(subjid, baseline_HTN = HTN)

longway_htn <- longway_com %>%
  left_join(baseline_htn, by = "subjid")

table(longway_htn$baseline_HTN, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
#fig3.5 individual SBP means over the three visits separated by sex and baseline hypertension status
sbp_means <- longway_htn %>%
  group_by(visit, sex, baseline_HTN) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sbp = mean(sbp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig3.5 <- xyplot(
  sbp ~ visit | baseline_HTN * sex,
  data = longway_htn,
  fun = mean,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Visit",
  ylab = "Mean Systolic Blood Pressure"
)
fig3.5

#individual SBP measurements over the three visits separated by sex and baseline hypertension status
fig3.5b <- xyplot(
  sbp ~ visit | baseline_HTN * sex,
  groups = subjid,
  data = longway_htn,
  type = "l",
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Visit",
  ylab = "Systolic Blood Pressure"
)
fig3.5b
```


### Chapter 5

```{r}
lm1 <- lm(sbp ~ YearsFromV1*sex, data = longway)
summary(lm1)

mflongway <- model.frame(lm1)

gls1 <- gls(sbp ~ YearsFromV1*sex, data = mflongway)
summary(gls1)


head(model.matrix(lm1))
```
